layout_sources: https://github.com/mlaitinen/ofxstatement-revolut (sample exports: the 10-column header Type,Product,Started Date,Completed Date,Description,Amount,Fee,Currency,State,Balance, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" date-times, signed Amount, Balance after the line, oldest first, UTF-8)
Same layout as eu-west/revolut-current-eur in this corpus
notes: Revolut app statement as CSV for a PLN account (Revolut Bank UAB, Polish branch). Comma-separated, unquoted, UTF-8 without BOM (Ż kept as two bytes), LF. Started and completed date-times; signed Amount with a point decimal, Fee, Currency PLN, State COMPLETED, Balance after the line; oldest first. The header is assumed to stay in English with the app set to Polish. Card payments complete the next day here: the expected dates are the Completed Date (when the balance changed). Closing = the last Balance; opening = the first Balance minus its amount.
